_comment: iOS 2.2.1 (5H11a) overlay on rootfs/recipe.json. Applied by scripts/versions.py into build/fw-2.2.1/recipe.json; the 4.2.1 recipe is never changed. 2.x has no dyld shared cache (frameworks are individual dylibs) and no MBXGLEngine/Substrate, so all cache patches, interposers, Cydia and TLSFix are left out. /System/Library/Caches/com.apple.dyld does not exist on this rootfs, so the 4.2.1 'enable-dylibs-to-override-cache' marker is not written either. Activation is patched directly in /usr/lib/liblockdown.dylib: an inserted 4.x-linked dylib could not be loaded by iOS 2.x dyld. The temporary DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES interposer is no longer installed.
_activation: SpringBoard's liblockdown calls lockdown_connect()/lockdown_copy_value() through /var/run/lockdown/localcomm. With no lockdownd there is no ActivationState and no UI. Since 2.x has no dyld cache, rootfs/recipe.json's liblockdown patches cannot be used: tools/ios3ds-lockdown221/lockdown221.c is inserted into SpringBoard instead and answers those calls locally.
_todo: Darwin 9 lacks IOSurface, CoreMotion and Celestial's 4.x API: our 4.2.1 GPU/gyro/camera userland binaries cannot simply be copied here. The activation interposer above is the only 4.2.1-derived tool installed on 2.2.1; input/MCU/Wi-Fi tools are still not installed (docs/multi-version.md §6.5).

extra_file_patches.why: 5H11a liblockdown: lockdown_connect -> 1 (fake handle) because __local_connect() to /var/run/lockdown/localcomm fails without lockdownd.
5H11a liblockdown: ARM stub for lockdown_copy_value; compares the requested CFStringRef (r2) with a local key/value table and returns the value, else NULL. Verified 44-byte original body replaced.

Offline activation table in a verified zero gap of liblockdown __TEXT: ActivationState = inline CFString 'Activated' (isa 0x38237da0 from this dylib), BrickState = CFBooleanFalse 0x38241c48. Other keys return NULL as on 4.x.

5H11a lockdown_disconnect -> 0. SpringBoard imports it and passes the fake handle from lockdown_connect (symbol VA 0x30893be4 from liblockdown's own symtab); without this stub it faults on a fake handle.
5H11a lockdown_remove_value -> 0 (symbol VA 0x308940a8; same reason as disconnect).

5H11a lockdown_set_value -> 0 (symbol VA 0x308940f4; same reason as disconnect). All three original byte sequences were verified in this dylib; the resign step re-signs the patched file for 2.x page signatures.
